name: Twitter Social
shortInfo: X: Leading online news and social networking site where people communicate in short messages.
brief: Twitter Social provides access to Twitter’s data for resources such as Tweets and Users.
about:
DataChannel’s Twitter Social Connector enables streaming relevant Twitter data into a user determined warehouse. This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency.

Check more about API Documentation [here](https://developer.x.com/en/docs/platform-overview).
availableData:
[Tweets](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/twitter-social/pipelines/tweets.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve a variety of information about a Tweet.

[User Metrics](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/twitter-social/pipelines/user-metrics.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the metrics about an authorized user.

[Users Blocked](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/twitter-social/pipelines/users-blocked.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the list of blocked users.

[Users Muted](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/twitter-social/pipelines/users-muted.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve the list of muted users.
